content.title: Who made it to national championship game? Schedule, where to watch, tickets, NCAA bracket
content.text: April 4, 2026, 11:32 p.m. ETThe 2026 NCAA men's basketball championship will be played in Indianapolis at Lucas Oil Stadium.Michigan will face UConn in the national championship game on Monday, April 6, 2026.UConn advanced to the final by defeating Illinois, while Michigan beat Arizona.The 2026 Final Four national championship game is set for Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.
